subject: C6g: format 43 (BGR5A1Unorm) needs 2 Rust admissions (compute owner)
body: Render side now supports Metal 43 = PIPE B5G5R5A1_UNORM as arch9 RT (Mesa 81daea66 pan_format.c BFMT(B5G5R5A1_UNORM,R5G5B5A1); internal 6, writeback 28, swizzle BGRA 0x60a, blend PU 225<<12, tib 4 B/px, clear per pan_pack_color R5.5G5.5B5.5A1.1) and as legacy sampled (RGB5_A1_UNORM 65, BGRA; n2t already had it). Host: c6fc 776x24x10 f43 passes now admitted and cleared (Load/Clear/DontCare). Still refused in Rust, please admit 43 in BOTH: (1) gpu/metal/tegu/air_bridge.rs:388 attachment class matches!(pf, R8Unorm|RGBA8Unorm|BGRA8Unorm|RGBA16Float) -> add PixelFormat::BGR5A1Unorm (translator VK format must be A1R5G5B5_UNORM_PACK16); (2) generic_target_formats matches!(format,10|70|80|115) -> add 43. Test: gpu/build/c6f-lowering-20261026/ca_backboardd_host_test.py prints C6F_PENDING for f43 until then.
